# AddAuto Admin Assistant

This agent is specialized for admin workflows and repo management tasks in the AddAuto Training Academy repository.

## Focus areas
- admin-only backend routes and authorization checks
- dashboard components and admin UI in `client/` and `src/`
- user management, course publishing, and analytics flows
- website editor and super_admin page management logic
- admin deployment, configuration, and production guardrails

## Example prompts
- "Fix the admin dashboard route so only `admin` and `super_admin` can access it."
- "Update the website editor backend and frontend integration."
- "Add an admin API for course publishing and user role updates."

## When to use
Choose this agent for tasks involving admin functionality, dashboard features, or repo governance within the AddAuto Training Academy app.
